## Où j'en suis
Draft PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57 (open) is up with the Terraform for the Postgres 17 blue/green upgrade on staging analytics RDS. Prod is prepared but disabled (`pg17_enabled = false`, `apply_immediately` false). Nothing has been applied. Staging plan: 1 to add, 1 to change. Prod plan: no changes.

- [prochaine-étape] Upgrade pg_partman 4.7.4 to 5.x on staging 16.4, then check `run_maintenance_proc()` on events_raw and events_daily.
- [prochaine-étape] Apply the staging blue/green only after the pg_partman upgrade, otherwise the green environment can't be created.
- [question] Prod window is undecided and needs Maya's sign-off; it must avoid the dbt lock on events_daily (01:00–03:30 UTC).
- [essai-raté] Provider bump to AWS v6 gave 37 unrelated changes (S3 ACL, `aws_eip.vpc`), so it was abandoned.
- [décision] Pin the AWS provider to ~> 5.82.0; no v6 in this PR (source: t04)
- [décision] No prod date before Maya signs off, and `apply_immediately` stays false on prod (source: t14)
